findings.body: `sync.files(top, cfg)` builds its expected file list from the worktree, but this guard compares it with `HEAD`. `githooks.ships` includes `CLAUDE.md` only while it exists in the worktree (`src/forge/githooks.py:71`), and `forge sync` deletes an old Forge-only copy (`src/forge/sync.py:271-274`). If that deletion remains uncommitted, this comparison omits the path even though the pull request still contains the obsolete file, so close can reach Ready. Build the comparison from committed inputs and include files that sync removes.
findings.title: Not done: An upgrade is not ready while synced files are out of date

findings.body: The SPEC-owned `tests/test_upgrade_check.py` calls `_close` after changing the upgrade pin without syncing (`tests/test_upgrade_check.py:82-89` and `165-170`). This new guard refuses those fixtures before they reach their check assertions, so the existing parameterized suite fails. Update SPEC's fixtures to commit the output of `forge sync` before closing.
findings.title: Later: SPEC upgrade-check tests must sync before close

findings.body: For `repo = "forge-source"`, `forge sync` also writes `docs/commands.md` (`src/forge/sync.py:314-319`), but `sync.files` does not include it. An upgrade of the source repo can therefore be marked Ready with a stale committed command page. Include that generated file in the close comparison.
findings.title: Include the command page that forge sync writes for the source repo
